answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 units of compute for an exclusive slot, ensuring a stable river of flow within the network. A global verifier inspects ledger occupancy to reject double-committed agents, viewing any overlap like a dark umber stain on the registry. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units, a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 unit penalty. Any evidence of identity reuse rises like a plume of smoke, triggering a 180-day lock on all collateral until full restitution concludes.
